python3 << 'EOF'
# NASA outlay data from FY 2008-2017 (in millions)
nasa_outlays = {
    2008: 17834,
    2009: 19168,
    2010: 18906,
    2011: 17617,
    2012: 17190,
    2013: 16978,
    2014: 17093,
    2015: 18272,
    2016: 18828,
    2017: 18698
}

# Convert to billions
values = [v / 1000 for v in nasa_outlays.values()]
print("NASA outlays (in billions):")
for year, val in zip(nasa_outlays.keys(), values):
    print(f"  {year}: {val:.3f}")

# Sort values for Winsorization
sorted_values = sorted(values)
print(f"\nSorted values: {sorted_values}")

# 10% Winsorized: replace bottom 10% and top 10% with next closest values
n = len(values)
print(f"\nNumber of observations: {n}")

# 10% of 10 = 1 observation each tail
# So we replace the minimum with the 2nd smallest, and maximum with 2nd largest
winsorized = values.copy()
winsorized[values.index(min(values))] = sorted_values[1]  # replace min with 2nd smallest
winsorized[values.index(max(values))] = sorted_values[-2]  # replace max with 2nd largest

print(f"Original values: {values}")
print(f"Winsorized values: {winsorized}")

# The 10% Winsorized range is the range (max - min) of the Winsorized data
winsorized_min = min(winsorized)
winsorized_max = max(winsorized)
winsorized_range = winsorized_max - winsorized_min

print(f"\nWinsorized min: {winsorized_min:.2f}")
print(f"Winsorized max: {winsorized_max:.2f}")
print(f"10% Winsorized range: {winsorized_range:.2f}")

# Round to hundredths place
print(f"\nFinal answer (rounded to hundredths): {winsorized_range:.2f}")
EOF
